description.value:
♍ Virgo is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake and you have your Ascendant Boon for the whole day.

Each time you hit with an unarmed Strike, the target must attempt a Will save against your Cosmo DC or lose a sense. Losses are cumulative: sight (blinded), hearing (deafened), smell and taste, then touch (−4 to attack rolls, cannot Grapple).

Senses lost this way return only through restoration or a full night's rest.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.

rules.text: On a hit, the target must attempt a Will save against your Cosmo DC or lose a sense.
rules.title: Six Paths of Transmigration
